# v1.0.7

## Added

- **Current character indicator.** An optional small always-on-top grid of squares mirroring your thumbnail layout, so you can see who's active at a glance without hunting across a bunch of previews.
  - Enable it in Settings → General → "Show current character indicator". Off by default.
  - The active client's square lights up gold; a client whose thumbnail is disabled shows red.
  - Only shown while one of your tracked EVE clients (or its thumbnail) has focus, and updates instantly on activation instead of lagging behind on a timer.
  - Drag it anywhere - the spot is remembered across restarts. "Lock indicator position" prevents further dragging.
  - "Make indicator clickable" turns each square into a shortcut: click one to activate that client, the same as clicking its thumbnail.
